description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Language' class within the Admin Controller startup namespace of the OpenCart project. It manages language initialization, configuration, and loading procedures in the admin interface.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Handles language setup and management for the admin startup controller in OpenCart, including language detection from cookies, configuration, and loading language files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings by loading available languages, setting default and cookie-based language preferences, and configuring language paths.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Post-processing method to ensure the language is correctly loaded and set after certain routes are processed, filling in default values if needed.
